name: Miraculous Gifts Of The Holy Spirit
overview: Scripture reveals that the miraculous gifts of the Holy Spirit were foretold as a powerful outpouring upon all believers, enabling prophecy, visions, and wonders as signs of God's presence and salvation (Joel 2:28-29). These gifts served to confirm the gospel and edify the Church, opening blind eyes and unstopping deaf ears as a demonstration of divine power (Isaiah 35:5-6). However, the New Testament also warns that such gifts can be counterfeited and misused, as many will claim to perform miracles in Christ’s name without true saving faith (Matthew 7:22).
